# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-20 from the 2026-11-20 Hub dump.

- 3,250,148 models tracked, 938,285 declare a base model, 971,658 parent links, 93,101 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
